description: This test ensures that users can navigate to the documentation page via the footer link and access API information.
steps: Scroll down to the footer section of the page.
Locate the Documentation link in the footer.
Assert that the Documentation page loads successfully.
Verify that the API information is displayed on the Documentation page.
expected_results: The Documentation page is loaded successfully.
API information is visible on the Documentation page.
edge_cases: Clicking the Documentation link results in a 404 error.
Page load times out due to network issues.
User's browser blocks navigation to external links.
Documentation page is inaccessible due to server downtime.
data_requirements: Functional Documentation link in the footer.
Valid API information displayed on the Documentation page.
dependencies: Footer section is correctly rendered on the login page.
Documentation server is up and running.
performance_metrics: Time taken to navigate to the Documentation page.
Page load time for the Documentation page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Documentation link is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Provide descriptive text for the Documentation link.
Verify that the Documentation page meets WCAG 2.1 standards.
